notes: Fresh original-only extraction from supplied published JCR article, 38(6), 988–1003 (2012 issue; 2011 copyright/online publication retained). Title and authors match supplied reference. Rendered PDF page 11 inspected: canonical text uses p for printed equals signs and ! for printed less-than signs; quotations retain these exact text-layer glyphs. Explicit ellipses omit interleaved text from the other column while retaining line-end hyphenation. No metric conversion. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Target is amount of mental simulation, not the separately reported ease-of-simulation test (F = 3.20, p = .08), nor the mediator-to-purchase-intentions regression. The rendered article says mismatch led to greater ease although its printed means run the other way; this wording discrepancy does not affect the amount-of-simulation target.
